about_short_description.short_description: Titan is a modern wealth management platform that solves urgent money problems for ambitious individuals.

product.name: Titan Wealth Management and Advisory
product.description: A technology-enabled wealth management service combining portfolio management, financial planning, and access to dedicated licensed Wealth Advisors and specialist Wealth Teams.

product.name: Titan Flagship
product.description: Titan’s core actively managed investment strategy, offering clients a professionally managed portfolio through the Titan wealth management platform.

product.name: Titan Diversify
product.description: A portfolio service for reducing concentrated stock exposure through planned, tax-aware sales and reinvestment, particularly for employees holding large positions in one company.

product.name: Titan Direct Indexing
product.description: A discretionary, long-only equity management service that builds a portfolio of individual stocks intended to track or reflect a broad-market index while supporting tax-aware management.

product.name: Smart Treasury
product.description: A cash-management investment strategy that invests predominantly in Treasury money market funds for near-term liquidity and tax-aware cash deployment.

product.name: Titan Opportunities
product.description: An investment offering providing access to selected investment opportunities beyond Titan’s core portfolio strategies, subject to availability and client suitability.
